objective: Reissue TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001D-P001 with the review's corrections: the explicit knot construction (psi = 0 on closed loops through band cores, disk-framed trivial leaves, pairwise disjoint Y-graphs, size bound), the novelty sentence (bounded H1 is not enough; not a refutation of Samperton-Weiss), the Turing-reduction wording, the characteristic-2 scope of the gadget lemma, the Hantzsche-Wendt remark labelled heuristic; add the knot-group corollary (+63) and its consequence for Rowell's Conjecture 3.2(b). Same checks plus the knot-group check.
status: Proved by CORRECTIONS-20261026-001D-P001 (reissue of TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001D-P001 after the independent review): counting homomorphisms to UT3(F4) x| C3 is #P-hard under Turing reductions on 3-surgeries of knots (H1 = Z/3) and on knot groups (the knot-group count is the surgery count plus 63), via the Potts gadget (Tutte at (79/15, 16)) and an explicit polynomial-size construction (disjoint disk-framed Y-graphs, psi = 0 on closed loops); Rowell's Conjecture 3.2(b) fails for this G unless every #P function is polynomial-time computable. Checks rerun.
title: Counting maps to UT3(F4) x| C3 is #P-hard with H1 = Z/3 (reissued)
